text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High egress errors observed in region sf1 at 2025-03-15T14:31Z. Error spike ~30% for outbound connections to third-party CDN. Paging on-call.
Priya Chen (oncall): I'm on it. reading metrics now — looks like spike started ~14:28Z.
Jamal Park (SRE): I see 502/504 spikes on the egress gateway for sf1 -> external:cdn.example.com. Circuit breakers tripping.
Elena Rivera (SRE): Checking NAT gateway and BGP sessions with cloud provider — any provider-side maintenance?
ops-bot: Provider events: no scheduled maintenance in sf1. Reported packet loss 0.8% in last 10m on egress subnet.
Priya Chen (oncall): Quick triage: is this affecting only external CDN host or all external egress?
Jamal Park (SRE): Tests: curl to google.com from sf1 instances OK. Failing specifically to cdn.example.com and its AS. Could be upstream peering / routing flaps.
Marco Diaz (Support): Any customer impact visible in the console? A few support tickets flagged timeouts for model inference webhooks.
Grace O'Neill (CustomerSuccess): We have two high-touch customers in sf1 with active traffic — flagged. Need status page and customer note if we reroute.
Priya Chen (oncall): OK plan: 1) Short-term mitigate: route affected egress for known cdn.example.com prefixes via backup transit (us-west1 egress) using policy-based routing on the egress gateway. 2) Notify status page, mark partial outage for sf1 egress to cdn.example.com. 3) Hand off to Jamal for routing change, Elena for provider engagement.
Jamal Park (SRE): prepping reroute. Command I'll run (dry-run first):
```bash
# add policy route for cdn.example.com prefixes to backup-egress-vpn
ip route add 203.0.113.0/24 via 10.10.20.1 table backup-egress
ip rule add from 10.0.0.0/16 lookup backup-egress
```
Priya Chen (oncall): tag me on each step. keep changes incremental and monitored.
ops-bot: Deploy window: immediate. Canary to 5% of requests for 30s then 100% if healthy.
Elena Rivera (SRE): I'm opening ticket with provider NOC, including pcap and traceroutes. Requesting BGP neighbor reset on their side.
Naomi Li (Product): Heads up — if we reroute some traffic to us-west1 latency may increase for customers in SF. We should include expected latency delta in customer note.
Grace O'Neill (CustomerSuccess): Draft customer note (short):
"We’re investigating outgoing network errors from our SF1 region that may cause timeouts to certain CDN providers. We are actively routing around the issue; some requests may see increased latency (typically +40–120ms). We’ll post updates here and notify affected accounts directly."
Marco Diaz (Support): LGTM. Suggest adding ETA for next update: 30 minutes post-reroute.
Jamal Park (SRE): Starting canary reroute now to 5% of traffic to cdn.example.com prefixes. Monitoring token-level errors and per-route latency.
ops-bot: Canary metrics: healthy for 30s. No increase in application errors on canary.
Jamal Park (SRE): Promoting reroute to 100%. Routing change complete at 14:41Z.
Priya Chen (oncall): Monitoring dashboards — errors dropping to baseline. Latency on rerouted requests shows +85ms median. No downstream timeouts reported in the last 5m.
Incident Bot: STATUS UPDATE: Partial mitigation applied — traffic to cdn.example.com from sf1 now routed via us-west1 backup.
Naomi Li (Product): Draft to status page:
"Investigating: Outgoing network errors to select external CDN endpoints from SF1 region. Impact: transient timeouts and increased latency for customers whose requests rely on the affected CDN. Mitigation: traffic to the affected CDN prefixes has been temporarily rerouted via our us-west1 backup egress to restore connectivity. Expected user-facing impact: timeouts are largely resolved; some requests may see ~40–120ms added latency. Next update: in 30 minutes or when remediation is complete."
Elena Rivera (SRE): Provider responded: seeing intermittent packet loss on their POP backbone; they are escalating to transport team. Keeping BGP session under watch.
Grace O'Neill (CustomerSuccess): I'll send targeted customer notifications to the two impacted customers with the latency note and that we’ve routed around the issue.
Marco Diaz (Support): Adding reactive messaging to the support playbook:
"If customer reports increased latency or webhook timeouts, notify them we’ve routed to backup egress and ask for traces and timestamps. If high severity, escalate to SRE oncall"
Priya Chen (oncall): Preparing handoff notes for next oncall starting in ~40m:
- Incident ID: INC-20250315-sf1-egress-01
- Summary: Partial egress outage to cdn.example.com prefixes from sf1 causing timeouts; mitigated via reroute to us-west1 backup at 14:41Z. Errors returned to baseline.
- Actions taken: provider engaged, policy-based routing change, canary -> full promotion, status page update, customers notified.
- Monitoring: watch egress error rate (egress.gateway.errors), per-route latency (egress.route.latency), BGP session stability.
- Rollback: revert ip rule and route if provider confirms fix and baseline healthy for 15m.
Jamal Park (SRE): Adding runbook snippet used for reroute to the incident thread for later writeup:
```text
Runbook (egress reroute):
1) Identify affected prefixes (whois/traceroute).
2) Add policy route to backup-egress table for prefixes.
3) Add ip rule for source subnets.
4) Canary 5% for 30s, check errors.
5) Promote to 100% if healthy, post status update.
6) Notify customers and record in incident log.
```
ops-bot: Incident INC-20250315-sf1-egress-01 created and linked to runbook.
Priya Chen (oncall): I'll put final note in the incident tracker and hand off to Elena for follow-through with provider. Elena, you're the primary for next 2 hours.
Elena Rivera (SRE): Got it. continuing provider engagement. leaving the channel for handoff at 15:11Z to next oncall.
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated for customer-facing errors. Please keep channel updated if any regression.
Priya Chen (oncall): Thanks team — nice quick mitigation. Grace/Marco — please follow up with the customers with the note and ETA.
Grace O'Neill (CustomerSuccess): Sending now, will add request for symptom logs from customers and offer to open a support case.
Marco Diaz (Support): Closing loop on support tickets we saw — will update with the incident link.
Naomi Li (Product): Logging for postmortem: include customer impact window, latency delta, and decision rationale for rerouting vs waiting for provider.
Jamal Park (SRE): I'll capture commands and exact timing in the incident timeline before we close.
Priya Chen (oncall): Handing off. End thread"
